info.title: ClaudeClaw Management API
info.description: The Daemon's HTTP/JSON + SSE API, served on the local socket or pipe and, when enabled, on the pinned-TLS remote listener.

AgenticSettings.description: `agentic`: model routing by the message's wording (TS `AgenticConfig`).

AttachmentUpload.description: One file sent with a Turn (management-api §2.3; the CLI's `send --file`).

AuditEntry.description: One audit-log line: who changed what, when; never a secret, a prompt or a value (#13, #44).

target.description:
An identifier (job name, Scope key, Device ID, a Housekeeping kind); `null` when the
action has none.

oneOf.description: Why it failed, when `outcome` is `error`.

count.description: How many things one aggregate entry covers, e.g. files one Housekeeping kind deleted.

AutoCompactState.description: The session's Auto-compact budget (#33): one compact per stretch of failures.

spent_at.description: When this stretch's compact was spent; `null` while the budget is unspent.

oneOf.description: The session's last auto-compact; `null` when it never had one.

Beacon.description: One stall-monitor beacon (#27 D5; management-api §8 item 10).

ChatOrigin.description:
The chat message a run answers, so the next Worker can send the interrupted reply (#29 D2,
D6).

ClaudeCodeSeen.description: The Claude Code version seen through a Launcher (#42 D5).

outdated.description: Below the minimum ClaudeClaw supports (#42 D4).

ClearedGiveUp.description: One entry of `give_ups[]`: a [`GaveUp`] that a person cleared (#45 D3).

Crash.description:
One Crash record entry (#20 D2, #27 D6, #29 D5, #36). Its `fatal` reason and `stderr_tail`
are redacted but still free text, so `Debug` prints only their sizes.

boot_id.description: The `boot_id` of the Worker that crashed.

fatal.description:
What the Worker sent as `fatal(reason)`, or the last stall report for `hung`; `null` if
nothing was sent.

counted.description: Whether it counts toward the Give-up (#27 D6).

reaped.description: The Reap after this exit (#29 D5).

stderr_tail.description: The redacted stderr tail, on the newest 5 crashes only: at most 40 lines and 8 KiB.

CrashExit.description:
How the Worker ended: `{"code": 101}` or `{"signal": "SIGSEGV"}` (#20 D2). One of the two is
set; a form added later in v1 parses with neither set.

code.description: The exit status. Wide enough for Windows statuses such as `0xC0000409` (#36).

DaemonStatus.description:
`status.get`, and `claudeclaw status --json` (management-api §2.1; #22 §5, #20). Served
online with `source: api`; the CLI fills it from disk when the Daemon doesn't answer. Fields
only a live Worker knows are `null` from disk.

state.description: A local state (#20 D1); always `running` when served.

oneOf.description: Who holds `daemon.lock`; CLI-only, `null` online (#22 §3).
The Run PATH (#26).
The Run locale (#43).
The Run index Back-fill's progress (#44).

config_dir_mismatch.description:
The advisory notice of #48: the login shell exports `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, but `direct`
runs use a different Config dir. Only the presence and the mismatch are reported, never
the value.

oneOf.description: `supervisor.json` (#20 D2); `null` when it doesn't exist (never started).

channelAllowedUserIds.description: Channel snowflake → extra user snowflakes allowed in that channel.

imageOutputRoots.description: Absolute path prefixes images may be uploaded from.

DiskHousekeeping.description: The last and next Housekeeping pass (#44 D7).

deleted.description: Files the last pass deleted, by kind (`inbox`, `run_logs`, `run_index`, …).

message.description: Never echoes a Launcher's arguments, a secret or request content (#8, #23 D6).

days.description: Weekdays, 0 = Sunday; every day when absent.

ExportManifest.description: What an export holds, without its text; `claudeclaw logs export --json` prints it (#28 D6).

map_written.description: The pseudonym key was written (`--map`, or `map=true`).

ExportTrimmed.description: Daemon-log lines dropped to fit `max_bytes`, in trimming order; never silent (#28 D6).

oldest_included.description: The oldest line still included; `null` when no line is.

ExportVersions.description: The versions in an export's Summary (#28 D1.2).

claudeclaw.description: The `claudeclaw` that made the export, as in `claudeclaw version`.

daemon.description: The running Daemon's version; `null` when none answered.

app.description: The Desktop app's version, when the app made the export.

ExportWindow.description: The time window the Daemon log and runs sections cover (#28 D1).

FallbackSettings.description: `fallback`: the model and token a rate-limited run retries with (TS `ModelConfig`).

GaveUp.description: `supervisor.json.gave_up`: the Give-up that holds every later start (#20 D2, #45 D1–D2).

oneOf.description: `null` until the first Held start (#45 D2).

reminded_at.description: The last reminder DM, sent at most once per 24 h (#45 D2).

oneOf.description: The First-start import's progress (#17), or `null` when none is running.

HousekeepingReport.description:
`housekeeping.run`'s answer (management-api §2.1, #44 D7). A dry run sets `would_delete`, a
real one `deleted`. Both map a kind (`inbox`, `run_logs`, …) to its totals.

freed_bytes.description: Freed, or that would be freed on a dry run.

dry_run.description: Report what would be deleted, and delete nothing.

HousekeepingTotal.description: One kind's totals in a [`HousekeepingReport`] (#44 D7).

step.description: The step running now, or `null` between steps.

InboxSettings.description: `inbox`: attachment retention (#44). `null` keeps forever / sets no cap.

InheritedFrom.description: A Scope, or `default` when nothing in the chain sets one.

LastTest.description: The summary of a Launcher's last test (management-api §2.5, #42).

claude_code_version.description: The Claude Code version the test saw; `null` when it saw none (#42 D5).

LauncherCheck.description:
One Test launcher check (management-api §2.5). Its `detail` never shows the Launcher's
arguments (#8).

advisory.description: An advisory check never makes the result's `ok` false (#39 D6).

oneOf.description: The last Test launcher result, kept in `daemon/state/launcher-tests.json`.
The Claude Code version seen through this Launcher, from its newest run or test (#42).

default.description: The default Launcher: `"direct"` or an absolute path.

LauncherSetResult.description:
`launchers.set` → the Scope's new Launcher and what happened to its session (management-api
§2.5).

session.description: `resumed` when the Scope already had a session with this Launcher (#8).

LauncherTestRequest.description:
`launchers.test` body (management-api §2.5, #40). A request for a Launcher already under test
joins that test.

launcher.description: The Launcher to test; the effective Launcher of `scope` when absent.

timeout_s.description: Seconds the test run may take, 10–600 (`422 invalid_value` otherwise).

ok.description: `false` if any check that isn't `advisory` failed.

oneOf.description: The Claude Code version the test run reported; `null` when it reported none (#42).

LauncherUnset.description: `launchers.unset` → the Launcher the Scope now inherits (management-api §2.5).

LauncherUse.description: A Scope that uses a Launcher (management-api §2.5).

direct_resolved.description: Where `direct` resolves on the Run PATH, or `null` if it doesn't (#26 D7).

Leftover.description: A Run registry entry a Reap could not end (#29 D5).

command.description: The CLI command doing an Offline write, e.g. `jobs import`.

LogCounts.description: ERROR and WARN lines since the Worker started (#23 D5).

LogDisk.description: What the Daemon keeps on disk (#23 D5, #44 D7).

inbox_foreign.description: Files under `inbox/*` the Daemon didn't write, and so never deletes.

free_bytes.description: Free space on the project dir's volume; `null` when it couldn't be read.

LogEntry.description:
One Daemon-log line from `logs.tail`, `logs.stream` or `claudeclaw logs --offline`
(#23 D5). A line that doesn't parse (a torn last line, foreign text) comes back as `Raw` and
is never skipped.

LogExport.description: `logs.export`: one reviewable Markdown file, already scrubbed (management-api §2.9, #28 D7).

map.description: The reverse map `{pseudonym: real value}`, only when the caller asked with `map=true`.

LogLine.description: A parsed Daemon-log line (#23 D2, D5). Content-free by #23 D6.

cursor.description: Opaque; pass it as `before`. Absent on streamed lines and in the Bug-report export.

seq.description: Per-process, restarting at 1; a gap means lost lines.

event.description: The stable dotted event name; required at INFO and above from workspace crates.

next.description: The `before` cursor for the next page, or `null` at the end.

scan_truncated.description: The 50 MB scan bound stopped this page before `limit` lines; `next` continues it.

LogSummary.description: `logs.summary`: badges for the Logs and Status screens (management-api §2.9; #23 D5, #44).

dropped_lines.description: Lines the Worker's sink dropped since boot (`log.dropped`).

capped_today.description: The daily cap was hit today (`log.capped`).

ProcessStamp.description:
An OS process start stamp, which proves a pid is still the process that was recorded (#29
D2–D3, #36). Exactly one field is set; an OS added later in v1 parses with none set,
which a reaper treats as unprovable.

RawLogLine.description: A Daemon-log line that didn't parse (#23 D5).

ReapedRun.description: One run of the last Reap (#29 D2, D6).

state.description: A `settling` run never makes its job or chat `interrupted` (#37 D3).

RegistryEntry.description: One spawned process in the Run registry (#29 D2, #37 D3).

pid.description: `null` while `spawning`. On Unix it is also the pgid.

oneOf.description: `null` while `spawning`.
The chat message that started it; `null` for jobs, the heartbeat and API Turns.

RemoteSettings.description: `remote`: the pinned-TLS remote listener (architecture §7). Changed only locally.

fingerprint.description: The certificate's SPKI fingerprint; `null` while remote access is off.

Revision.description: The first 16 hex digits of SHA-256 over the file's bytes. Send it back as `If-Match`.

RunIndexState.description:
The Run index Back-fill's progress, so partial answers are labelled (#44 D2). Also served in
`DaemonStatus.run_index`, `UsageReport.coverage.index` and `JobsAudit.index`.

done.description: TS Run logs indexed so far by the current Back-fill.

total.description: TS Run logs the current Back-fill found missing.

RunLocale.description: `DaemonStatus.run_locale`: the character type every run gets (#43 D5).

lc_ctype_added.description: The `LC_CTYPE` value added to every run, or `null` when none was added.

verified.description: `false` when `locale` wasn't found and `C.UTF-8` was used unchecked (#43 D3).

RunModelUsage.description: One model's share of a run, per run by difference (#39 D8).

RunPage.description: `runs.list`: running runs first, then the index newest first (management-api §2.9).

next.description: The `before` cursor for the next page, or `null` at the end.

RunPath.description: `DaemonStatus.run_path`, the PATH every run gets (#26 D7).

source_used.description: The source actually used, after `auto` and any fallback.

shell.description: The login shell's basename; `null` when no shell was run.

oneOf.description: Why the capture failed, or `null`.

dropped_entries.description: Empty or relative entries left out.

prepend.description: Absolute dirs put first on the Run PATH.

RunRecord.description:
One spawned run: a line of `daemon/runs/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl`, and what `runs.get` returns
(management-api §2.9, #23 D4). Refused runs get one too; every run in a Turn gets its own,
sharing `turn_id` (#33). Back-filled TS records (`origin: ts`) leave every Rust-only measure
`null` (#44 D2).

oneOf.description: `null` for back-filled TS records, whose header names no Scope.

launcher.description: `direct` or the Launcher's file name; `null` for back-filled TS records.

oneOf.description: `null` only while `state` is `running`.

attempt.description: Counts up within a Turn (#33); 1 for back-filled TS records.

oneOf.description: Absent once the run has finished; `running` on the in-memory runs `runs.list` puts first.

cost_usd.description: Per run, by difference against the Cost baseline; `null` when it can't be known (#39).

models.description: Per model, subagents included; empty when there was no usage (#39).

run_log.description: The project-relative Run log, or `null` (Refused runs and compact runs write none).

launcher_resolved.description: The executable the Launcher resolved to (#26).

oneOf.description: `null` for back-filled TS records (#33).
`null` when nothing was spawned to settle (#37).

awake_ms.description: The runner's own measure, without suspended time (#38).

wake_grace.description: A Wake grace moved the run's deadline (#38).

claude_code_version.description: `null` for back-filled TS records and Refused runs (#42).

lingered.description:
`claude` lingered after `result`; not a timeout for Auto-compact or the Timeout breaker
(#47).

RunRegistry.description:
`daemon/state/runs.json`, the Run registry: every process the Worker spawned that isn't
settled yet (#29 D2, #37 D3; architecture §4 "claudeclaw-api").

oneOf.description: Written first thing at Worker start; `null` when no Worker runs.

leftovers.description: Entries a Reap could not end (#29 D5).

reaped.description: The last Reap's results, consumed and cleared by the next Worker (#29 D6).

RunSettle.description: What happened to the run's process group after the leader exited (#37).

stragglers.description: Group members alive at leader exit; best-effort on Windows.

pipe_held.description: Something outside the group still held the output pipe.

Runnable.description: Whether a Launcher can be run now (management-api §2.5, #8).

oneOf.description: Why not; `null` when `ok`.

Scope.description: A Scope: `global`, `discord:<id>` (channel or thread), `job:<name>` (`<agent>/<stem>` for an agent's job) or `agent:<name>`.

ScopeInfo.description:
One Scope for the Chat picker and the "Who uses which launcher" table (management-api §2.5).
Listed: `global`, every Discord channel or thread with config, a session or an override,
every job and every agent.

label.description: A display name. The app shows it and copies `scope` (#16).

oneOf.description: The Scope this one inherits from: a thread's channel. `null` when there is none.
The session of the effective Launcher; `null` when there is none.

ScopeLauncher.description:
One row of the scope → effective-Launcher table (management-api §2.5, #8, #22). Also embedded
in `DiscordChannel` and `AgentInfo`.

set_here.description: The override set on this Scope itself: `"direct"`, an absolute path, or `null`.

effective.description: The Launcher a Turn here runs with.

inherited_from.description:
Where `effective` comes from: a Scope up the chain (thread → channel → global), or
`default`. Names this Scope itself when `set_here` or the job frontmatter sets it.

running.description: Whether a Turn is running in the Scope now.

ScopeSession.description:
The session summary embedded in `ScopeInfo`, `DiscordThread` and `AgentInfo`
(management-api §2.5, §2.7, §2.8).

SecretState.description: How a secret reads: whether it is set, never its value (management-api §2.6, #13).

name.description: The launchd label or the systemd unit, best effort; `null` when it couldn't be read.

SessionCompacted.description:
What a manual compact did: `TurnRecord.compact` (management-api §2.5 `sessions.compact`,
#40 D7).

context_before.description:
The session's context in tokens before the compact (`context.used_tokens`, #39 D4);
`null` when it isn't known, e.g. an imported session before its first Rust Turn.

context_after.description: The same after the compact; `null` when it failed.

SessionContext.description: How full a session's context window is (#39 D4).

used_tokens.description: The last main-thread turn's input + cache read + cache creation tokens.

oneOf.description: From the session's latest Daemon run; `null` until an imported session's first Rust Turn.

SessionDetail.description: `sessions.get` → the session plus its context meter (management-api §2.5, #39 D4).

first_message.description:
The session's first message, cut to 160 chars. `null` when it isn't known (an imported
session).

prune_at.description: When the 30-day prune removes it; `null` while it is `in_use`.

SessionReset.description:
`sessions.reset` → the cleared session and its backup, mirror included (management-api
§2.5, #22).

backup.description: Where the session was backed up; `null` when there was no session to back up.

launcher.description: The session's Launcher; the Scope's current one when absent.

summaryPath.description: The dir summaries are written to before a rotation; empty disables them.

Settings.description:
The typed view of the `settings.json` keys the Rust Daemon reads, after defaults
(management-api §2.6, architecture §7). Existing keys keep TS's names and types
(`src/config.ts`); Rust-only keys are new top-level keys (#14 rule 1). Unknown and TS-only
keys are never shown.

api.description: The auth token runs get as `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`.

transcript_roots.description: Absolute dirs searched for Transcripts when a run's Config dir isn't known (#39 D2).

SettingsApplied.description: `settings.update` → the new view, what changed and what was restarted (management-api §2.6).

changed_keys.description: Dotted paths of the keys whose value changed.

SettingsPatch.description:
`settings.update` body: a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) over the file's own key names
(management-api §2.6, D10). A secret is set with a string and cleared with `null`.

SettingsView.description: `settings.get` → the typed view and its Revision (management-api §2.6).

ts_only_keys.description:
Dotted paths of TS-only keys present in the file (`web.port`, `apiToken`, …). They are
read for import only and can't be written here (`422 ts_only_key`).

env_overrides.description: Dotted paths of keys an env var wins over, e.g. `discord.token` for `DISCORD_TOKEN`.

cli.description: The CLI's own version; only the CLI sets it.

deadline_at.description: When the drain ends at the latest (#9).

StopRecord.description: `supervisor.json.stop`, the last intentional stop (#20 D2, #45 D3).

SupervisorStatus.description:
`daemon/state/supervisor.json`, written by the Watchdog on every transition and embedded in
`DaemonStatus.supervisor` (#20 D2; architecture §4 "Status file"). Every change after
`schema: 1` is additive (#27, #29, #36, #45).

schema.description: [`SupervisorStatus::SCHEMA`]. A reader that sees a higher value reports `unknown` (#20 D1).

oneOf.description: `null` when no Worker is running.
The last intentional stop, or `null` if there was none.

hang_kill.description: `false` when `CLAUDECLAW_HANG_KILL=0` turned the Hang kill off (#27 D3).

oneOf.description: `null` unless `state` is `gave_up`.

give_ups.description: Cleared Give-ups, newest first, the last 10 (#45 D3).

crashes.description: The Crash record: newest first, the last 20. It carries across Watchdog starts (#20 D2).

TimeoutBreakerSettings.description: `timeout_breaker` (#32). Each limit is `null` when off; both `null` turns the breaker off.

failing_since.description: The first timeout since the last success; `null` when there is none.

open.description: Open means no auto-compact and no retry until a Turn succeeds.

TimeoutSettings.description: `timeouts`: run timeouts in minutes, by category (TS `TimeoutsConfig`).

tools.description: The names of the tools the message called, in order.

TranscriptPage.description: `sessions.messages` → one page of a Transcript, newest first (management-api §1.6, §2.5, #39).

next.description: The `before` cursor of the next older page; `null` at the start.

oneOf.description: A piece of the reply as it streams.

TurnEvent.description:
One event on `turns.events`, tagged by `kind`. The stream replays from the Turn's start
and ends after `outcome`.

TurnRecord.description:
A Turn as `turns.get` and `?wait=` return it (management-api §2.3, #40). It matches #22's
`send --json`.

principal.description:
The API principal that created it (`local`, `device:<id>`, `token:<id>`); `null` when the
Turn didn't come through the API.

oneOf.description: `null` until `state` is `done`.

text.description: The reply text; `null` until done, or when there is none.

oneOf.description: Set when `purpose` is `compact`.

session_id.description: `null` until the first run has a session.

launcher.description: `direct` or a Launcher path; `null` until the Turn's first run resolves it.

run_ids.description: Every run the Turn spawned, in order: the first attempt, a compact, a retry (#33).

attachments.description: At most 5, 10 MB each. Written to `inbox/api/` and handed to Claude as files.

notify.description: Also send the reply to the owner through every adapter's `Notifier` (#22 `send --notify`).

UpdateInfo.description:
`update.get` and `update.check`: the Worker's daily release check (management-api §2.1; #6,
#35 §7). The channel follows from the running version.

latest.description: The newest release on this channel; `null` before the first successful check.

UsageCoverage.description: What the sums leave out, so a total is never silently partial (#39 D11, #44).

index_from.description: The oldest run in the Run index; `null` when it is empty.

runs_without_usage.description: Runs with no usage, e.g. back-filled TS records.

runs_unknown_price.description: Runs whose basis is `unknown`: tokens counted, cost left out.

UsageReport.description:
`usage.get`: one Daemon's usage between two dates in the caller's `tz` (management-api
§2.10). Every cost sum skips `null` costs, and `coverage` counts what was skipped.

tz.description: The IANA time zone the caller chose for day boundaries.

key.description: The group's identity: a Scope key, a Launcher, a model ID or a job name.

label.description: What the app shows, e.g. a channel name for a `discord:<id>` Scope.

launcher.description: The Launcher behind the row's runs; `null` when they used several.

cache_hit_pct.description: Percent (0–100) of input tokens read from cache; `null` with no input tokens.

cost_usd.description: `null` when no run in the report was priced.

oneOf.description: The weakest trust over the priced runs; `null` with `cost_usd`.

stamp.description: The OS start stamp that `stop` checks before it signals `pid` (#36).

oneOf.description: `null` unless started with `--service-manager` (#45 D4).

reaped.description: The start-up Reap's counts, recorded against this Watchdog start (#29 D5).

WindowsStamp.description: `GetProcessTimes`' creation time as a FILETIME (#29 D2).
